test_compressed_urls: test reading compressed URLs with pandas read_csv using various engines and compression modes
test_url_encoding_csv: test that pandas read_csv honors the requested encoding when reading CSV data from a URL
test_parse_public_s3_bucket: test reading CSV from a public S3 bucket using pandas read_csv with s3fs storage options
test_parse_private_s3_bucket: test that pandas read_csv raises FileNotFoundError when accessing a private S3 bucket
test_parse_public_bucket_s3n_s3a: test reading CSV from public S3 bucket using s3n and s3a URL schemes with pandas read_csv
test_parse_public_s3_bucket_chunked: test reading CSV from S3 in chunks using pandas read_csv with chunksize parameter
test_infer_s3_compression: test that pandas read_csv infers compression from file extension when reading from S3
test_read_s3_fails: test that pandas read_csv raises OSError when the specified S3 bucket does not exist
test_read_csv_handles_boto_s3_object: test reading a boto3 S3 object as a BytesIO buffer with pandas read_csv
test_read_csv_chunked_download: test that pandas read_csv uses chunked downloads when reading large files from S3
test_read_s3_with_hash_in_key: test that pandas read_csv handles S3 keys containing hash characters
test_read_feather_s3_file_path: test reading a feather file from S3 using pandas read_feather with storage options
